card.name: Word endings in surnames and "falls off"
card.fires_on: The ending of a German-style surname (-mann, -loff, -off) after a name start, and the word "off" right after fall/falls/fell.

modes.label: Surname endings
modes.description: Final piece of a split surname such as Ehlmann, Rudloff, Thälmann or Sokoloff.
modes.example: Gordon Rud<<loff>> Ohio Department of Agriculture

modes.description: The word "off" after fall, falls or fell, often about a patch or dressing coming loose.
